title: The Open Grave
text: A barrow lies open to the sky, its stone door pulled off and thrown aside like a blanket. The bier inside is empty. The shroud lies beside it, folded neatly, the way someone folds their bedclothes before going out for the day.

options.label: The hardiest searches the empty barrow in case its owner left in a hurry.

outcomes.text: Whoever walked out left grave goods behind. They may want them back.
Whoever walked out has come back for their things.

options.label: Close the barrow again, so whoever left has no bed to return to.

outcomes.text: Lifting the door takes all of you, and every arm aches after. The barrow seems quieter for it.
